name: mr-x-sentinel
description: Mr-X Sentinel — plateforme Discord unifiée (sécurité, mod, logs, économie, XP, IA)

scripts.build:ci: pnpm --filter @sentinel/shared build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/database build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/core build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/bot build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/dashboard build
scripts.dev: pnpm run docker:up && concurrently -n bot,dash,worker -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @sentinel/bot dev" "pnpm --filter @sentinel/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @sentinel/bot dev:worker"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sentinel/shared build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/database build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/core build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/bot typecheck && pnpm --filter @sentinel/dashboard typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sentinel/shared build && pnpm --filter @sentinel/database test && pnpm --filter @sentinel/core test && pnpm --filter @sentinel/shared test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build:ci
